title: Big web orders

rules: `total` is more than 200.00. An order of exactly 200.00 doesn't count.
Return every column of `orders`, unchanged. Keep duplicate rows.
hints: This needs two conditions: one on `channel`, one on `total`.
Join them with `&`, each in its own parentheses: `(cond1) & (cond2)`.
